extraction_note: Requirements extracted verbatim in intent from the PRD. hardware_verified reflects what has been physically proven on NomadLink One hardware to date. Where the PRD is factually wrong about the hardware, the correction is recorded in docs/decisions/ADR-002 and the requirement is flagged.

requirements.title: Wi-Fi SoftAP with internal DHCP
requirements.description: Broadcast customizable SoftAP (e.g. NomadLink-XXXX), run internal DHCP server issuing 192.168.4.x addresses, support captive portal redirect on initial connection.
requirements.verification_note: Not yet attempted.

requirements.title: Wi-Fi STA scan, credential entry and auto-connect
requirements.description: Web UI scans available networks, accepts SSID/password, auto-connects on boot with fallback to cellular.
requirements.verification_note: Not yet attempted.

requirements.title: Cellular connection management over A7670E
requirements.description: A7670E managed via UART AT commands / PPP. Automatic APN detection. Real-time monitoring of RSSI, registration state, operator name.
requirements.verification_note: VERIFIED. AT+CSQ, AT+CEREG?, AT+COPS? all respond. Registered on Airtel MCC 40490 / MNC 90, +CEREG: 0,1, CSQ 26,99 with patch antenna attached. Data bearer active: +CGPADDR: 1,100.90.93.199.

requirements.title: Dual-WAN automatic failover with NAT routing
requirements.description: Primary WAN is Wi-Fi STA, secondary is 4G LTE. On Wi-Fi loss or internet loss, seamlessly route all SoftAP client traffic over LTE via LwIP IP forwarding / NAT. Recovery within 3 seconds of packet loss detection.
requirements.verification_note:
Precondition now proven, feature not yet implemented. TASK-020 (2026-09-29) verified on hardware that PPP negotiates end to end on the Airtel SIM: lwIP reached phase RUNNING with local=100.76.140.112 and gateway=10.64.64.64, held stable, and reproduced on a cold boot at local=100.77.131.255. See TEST-020 and BUG-006. That establishes the IP interface NAT forwarding requires.

Still unverified, and what actually gates this requirement: IP forwarding configuration, the NAT/SoftAP data path itself, dual-WAN failover behaviour, and the 3-second recovery target. Also note the negotiated address is carrier-grade NAT (100.x.x.x), so the LTE leg is outbound-only and not reachable inbound.

requirements.title: Camera capture and MJPEG stream over HTTP
requirements.description: Capture frames from OV2640/OV5640 via ESP32-S3 camera interface using PSRAM for frame allocation. Stream MJPEG over HTTP /stream.
requirements.verification_note: VERIFIED at sensor level. OV2640 confirmed MID 0x7fa2 PID 0x0026 VER 0x0042, SCCB addr 0x30. 320x240 RGB565 in PSRAM, luma stddev 15.4 (non-zero variance proves a live sensor). MJPEG over HTTP is NOT yet verified.

requirements.title: Camera control web page
requirements.description: Endpoint /camera with resolution (QVGA/VGA/SVGA), JPEG quality slider, frame rate adjustment, snapshot capture.
requirements.verification_note: Not yet attempted.

requirements.title: GNSS acquisition, NMEA parsing and position fix
requirements.description: Communicate with A7670E GNSS via AT commands. Parse raw NMEA to extract latitude, longitude, altitude, speed, fix status, satellite count.
requirements.verification_note: VERIFIED. Cold-start fix 18.480776, 73.897998 in 69 seconds uninterrupted, 17 GPS + 10 GLONASS satellites, C/N0 up to 73. Requires PWRKEY GPIO42 power-on pulse and CGNSSPORTSWITCH=1,1. See ADR-002 and LESSONS_LEARNED.md.
requirements.spec_defect: PRD FR-3.1 names AT+CGNSINF, which does not exist on this module. AT+CGPSINFO is valid. Corrected per ADR-002.

requirements.title: Cellular LBS position fallback
requirements.description: When no GNSS fix is available, obtain an approximate position from the cellular network using AT+CLBS=1,1, reporting longitude/latitude and an accuracy radius in metres.
requirements.verification_note: VERIFIED. AT+CLBS=1,1 returned +CLBS: 0,18.481703,73.897415,550. Independently corroborated by the GPS fix at 18.480776, 73.897998 (separation well within the reported 550 m accuracy). Requires the 4G patch antenna attached (CSQ 16 -> 26) and AT+SIMEI populated from AT+CGSN. NOTE: this requirement is not in the PRD; it was added after hardware testing showed a real, working fallback exists.

requirements.title: Location web page with live map
requirements.description: Display live latitude, longitude, altitude, speed, satellite count. Embedded interactive Leaflet.js / OpenStreetMap map showing real-time location marker.
requirements.verification_note: Not yet attempted.

requirements.title: Cloud broker credential configuration UI
requirements.description: HiveMQ: broker URL, port (8883 MQTTS / 1883 MQTT), client ID, username, password, telemetry topic, command topic. Adafruit IO: username, AIO key, location feed key, command feed key.
requirements.verification_note: Not yet attempted. Credentials must be stored in NVS and never committed to the repository.

requirements.title: Telemetry publish controls and interval
requirements.description: Select destination (Disabled / HiveMQ / Adafruit IO). Start/stop publication from web UI. Configurable interval 5 to 3600 seconds.
requirements.verification_note: Not yet attempted.

requirements.title: Direct MQTT telemetry publish from device over LTE
requirements.description: Publish device telemetry to a cloud broker directly from the device over the cellular data path, with no external bridge, tunnel or relay. No cloudflared, no reverse proxy, no machine-dependent relay.
requirements.verification_note: NOT VERIFIED END TO END. The transport is proven: AT+CIPOPEN returns +CIPOPEN: 0,10 to broker.hivemq.com:1883, which is the command the TinyGSM A7672x driver uses. AT+CIPSTART returns ERROR on this firmware and must not be used. A full MQTT CONNECT plus CONNACK plus broker-received payload from the device has NOT yet been observed. An independent macOS subscriber has confirmed the broker side round trip on the user's HiveMQ Cloud cluster over WSS 8884, but that is not the device path.

requirements.title: MQTT subscriber command engine
requirements.description: Subscribe to command topic, parse JSON command payloads (command_id, action, params), execute GET_STATUS / TOGGLE_ROUTER / REBOOT / SEND_SMS / DIAL_NUMBER, and publish a result to a response topic with matching command_id.
requirements.verification_note: Not yet attempted. Depends on TASK-405 completing first.

requirements.title: SMS receiver engine with whitelist
requirements.description: Intercept incoming SMS via +CMTI URC, read with AT+CMGR, check sender against authorized whitelist before acting.
requirements.verification_note: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. Outbound SMS confirmed working: +CMGS: 2 and +CMGS: 3, both received by the user. AT+CNMI=2,1,0,1,0 is required to get delivery reports. AT+CMGL="SENT" is NOT supported (CMS ERROR: Operation not allowed). Inbound +CMTI interception and whitelist enforcement not yet implemented.

requirements.title: SMS command parser and auto-reply
requirements.description: Case-insensitive commands: STATUS (IP, WAN mode, signal, GPS), LOCATION (Google Maps link), STREAM ON/OFF, REBOOT, CALL <number>. Reply to sender via AT+CMGS.
requirements.verification_note: Not yet attempted. Depends on TASK-501.

requirements.title: Incoming call management with auto-answer and whitelist
requirements.description: Detect RING/+CLIP. Configurable auto-answer after N rings (ATA), auto-reject unauthorized (ATH), whitelist mode, web UI popup with Accept/Hang Up.
requirements.verification_note: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. Outgoing call confirmed: +VOICE CALL: BEGIN, active call state +CLCC: 1,0,2, user heard audio. Poll AT+CLCC? for state 2=active, 4=held; hang up with AT+ATH. Incoming call detection and whitelist not yet implemented.

requirements.title: Outgoing call execution and dialpad UI
requirements.description: Dial arbitrary numbers or saved contacts from web dialpad or API (ATD<number>;). Show call duration, connection state, active status. Full-duplex I2S audio via MEMS mic and speaker DAC.
requirements.verification_note: ATD dialing is proven. The web dialpad and the full-duplex I2S audio path are NOT verified. See RISK-003: the board's audio codec/mic wiring is unconfirmed and nomad-sentinel TASKS.md 1.11 records the audio path as UNSUPPORTED/unknown.

requirements.title: Offline speech recognition engine (ESP-SR)
requirements.description: ESP-SR with WakeNet + MultiNet running on ESP32-S3 vector instructions, fully offline, no cloud voice API and no per-use fees.
requirements.verification_note: Not attempted. PRD NFR requires recognition latency strictly under 800 ms; that target is unvalidated. See RISK-004.

requirements.title: Voice contacts directory with wake-word dialing
requirements.description: Web UI to manage contacts and assign phonetic triggers (e.g. 'Call Amma' -> +91 <10-digit-number>). Sequence: wake word 'Hi ESP' with audio feedback beep, 5 second recognition window, command match, verbal confirmation, then ATD dial.
requirements.verification_note: Not attempted. Depends on REQ-018 and on the audio hardware being confirmed present.

requirements.title: Asynchronous responsive web portal
requirements.description: ESPAsyncWebServer-hosted SPA with navigation: Dashboard, Network & Router Setup, Live Camera, Location & Mapping, Telemetry & Commands, SMS Manager, Telephony & Voice Dialing.
requirements.verification_note: Not attempted. This is the integration surface for most other modules and is scheduled early for that reason.

requirements.title: NVS persistence of configuration and secrets
requirements.description: Persist Wi-Fi credentials, cloud API keys, contacts, voice trigger mappings, SMS whitelist and APN config across reboot in NVS / LittleFS.
requirements.verification_note: Not started as a product feature, but the specific Rule 27 violation found during bootstrap is now closed: the hardcoded broker credential was removed from the tracker sketch, which now reads a gitignored secrets.h. All 7 baseline sketches compile and the secrets scanner passes. Remaining work is TASK-402: move ALL configuration (Wi-Fi, APN, contacts, SMS whitelist) into NVS so no secret or setting is hardcoded. The exposed credential must still be rotated at the broker; removal is not rotation.

requirements.title: Security hardening
requirements.description: WPA2-PSK / WPA3-SAE SoftAP, HTTP Basic Auth on the admin portal, telephony and SMS whitelisting, TLS 1.2/1.3 for all cloud connectivity. No secrets in source control.
requirements.verification_note: Not attempted. TLS on the cellular path is untested: AT+CSSLCFG and SNI are unverified on firmware A011B04A7670M7_F. See RISK-005.

requirements.title: SD card storage for captures and logs
requirements.description: FAT32 SD card mounted for storing camera snapshots, GNSS track logs and device logs.
requirements.verification_note: VERIFIED on the Arduino sketch path: 3,984,588,800-byte FAT32 card, write/read/delete round trip passed. Pins SD_MMC.setPins(5, 4, 6) with 20000 kHz. CONFLICT: nomad-sentinel/TASKS.md 1.7 records SD as BLOCKED under ESP-IDF with err=0x107 on all card commands. The Arduino path works and the IDF path does not; this discrepancy is tracked as RISK-006 and BUG-001.
